name: manual_b7daef
claim: gbrain sync failures can accumulate (2114+ in one session). When sync blocks: check ~/.gbrain/sync-failures.jsonl to see actual error, run 'gbrain doctor' for health status, fix root cause (usually config or API key), clear old state (rm ~/.gbrain/sync-*.json), then retry sync. If error is 'git pull failed', likely due to protocol.file.allow git security setting — not a blocker, sync continues on full reimport.

decisions.notes: Session 2026-07-04 encountered 2114+ OpenAI embedding failures blocking sync. Standard recovery: (1) read sync-failures.jsonl to identify pattern, (2) run gbrain doctor for detailed diagnostics, (3) fix root cause (in this case: wrong embedding provider), (4) clear sync state (rm ~/.gbrain/sync-*.json), (5) re-run gbrain sync. Sync completed successfully after fix.
